dateline: Toronto-bound — J-Hope and RM drew ARMY backlash for attending Chris Brown and Usher's Toronto concert (Aug 13); 'SWIM' earned two 2026 MTV VMA nominations (Song of the Year, Best K-Pop) announced Aug 18; Toronto ARMY rallies ahead of BTS's first Canadian shows since 2018 at Rogers Stadium (Aug 22-23)
heroHeadline: Day 4,816: 'SWIM' Lands 2 MTV VMA Nods as Toronto ARMY Readies for Rogers Stadium Homecoming
heroSubtitle: August 20, 2026 is Day 4,816 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. On Aug 13, J-Hope and RM attended the second of two Toronto stops on Chris Brown and Usher's co-headlining 'R&B Tour' at Rogers Stadium, posing with Brown in photos he posted to Instagram; the appearance drew backlash from segments of the ARMY fanbase citing Brown's history of violence, per CBC News and NOW Toronto. On Aug 18, MTV announced its 2026 Video Music Award nominations, with 'SWIM' earning two nods — Song of the Year and Best K-Pop — ahead of the Sept 27 ceremony at the Peacock Theatre in Los Angeles, per the Korea Times and Korea Herald. With BTS's own two-night Rogers Stadium stand two days out (Aug 22-23) — the group's first Canadian shows since 2018 — Toronto ARMY describes a citywide buildup fans are calling a homecoming, per CP24 and CHCH News. The tour advances after Toronto to Chicago's Soldier Field (Aug 27-28).
